ValidationRule.description: Following fields are mandatory if Account is a Partner Account - Partner Flag, Partner Manager, Partner Status, Partner Type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Partner"), OR( IM_Partner_Flag__c =FALSE, ISBLANK( IM_Partner_Manager__c ), ISPICKVAL( IM_Partner_Status__c,"" ), ISPICKVAL( IM_Partner_Type__c,"") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Partner Flag, Partner Manager, Partner Status, Partner Type info for this Partner Account.
